KIT header

Source: R/setup.R
kit_header.Rd

A lime color block, black border, header shadow; the full logo on the left, and on the right the tool name, one subtitle line, and one version line. One per app, at the very top (kit_page() already places it). It also sets the browser tab icon (the bean logo for KIT).

Usage

kit_header(
  title,
  subtitle = NULL,
  tagline = NULL,
  version = NULL,
  date = NULL,
  meta_extra = NULL,
  logo = TRUE,
  show_kitdesign = FALSE,
  brand = kit_current_brand(),
  package = NULL
)

Arguments

title

The tool name (the header's h1, also the browser tab title), for example "KIT 資料串接工具" ("KIT data join tool").

subtitle

The subtitle (bold), for example the database name "臺灣幼兒發展調查資料庫" (the KIT database).

tagline

A phrase after the subtitle (for example "跨波次資料處理", "cross-wave data processing"); NULL shows nothing.

version, date

The version and date on the header's version line, usually read from the app's own DESCRIPTION: kit_app_description("kitJoin").

meta_extra

Text added after the version line (for example "kits 0.25.0").

logo

Whether the header shows the brand logo (KIT's is the bean plus the KIT wordmark): TRUE (the logo file comes from an htmlDependency; use in Shiny), "inline" (the logo is written into the page, for single HTML files without Shiny, such as user manuals), or FALSE.

show_kitdesign

Whether to add the kitDesign version after the version line ("kitDesign 0.1.0"), so both versions are visible when someone reports a problem.

brand

The brand: logo, tab icon, and colors (kit_brand()). Defaults to kit_current_brand(): KIT when options(kitDesign.brand = ) is not set.

package

The app's package name, written at the start of the version line: "kitJoin v0.6.0 · 2026-10-31". Anyone reporting a problem can see at once which app and which version. NULL (the default) writes no name, as before.

Value

<div class="kit-header mb-4">.

Details

Logo, tab icon, and colors come from the brand (kit_brand()). When the brand's colors differ from KIT's, the header adds a short <style> that overrides the differing --nb-* variables; for the KIT brand nothing is added and the page is the same as before.

Examples

kit_header("KIT 資料串接工具", "臺灣幼兒發展調查資料庫", tagline = "跨波次資料處理",
           version = "0.6.0", date = "2026-10-31", package = "kitJoin")
#> <div class="kit-header mb-4">
#>   <div class="kit-header-row">
#>     <img src="kitDesign-logo-0.5.2/kit-logo.svg" alt="KIT 標誌" class="kit-header-logo"/>
#>     <div>
#>       <h1>KIT 資料串接工具</h1>
#>       <p>
#>         <span class="kit-subtitle">臺灣幼兒發展調查資料庫</span>
#>          · 
#>         跨波次資料處理
#>       </p>
#>       <div class="kit-app-meta">kitJoin v0.6.0 · 2026-10-31</div>
#>     </div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
